video_title: Sophie Cunningham is ‘AN AMERICAN HERO’: Former NBA player

quotes.speaker: Enes Kanter Freedom
quotes.summary_phrase: Enes Kanter Freedom praises Lara Trump as an American hero
quotes.excerpt: First of all, I want to say she's an American hero.
quotes.quote: First of all, I want to say she's an American hero. Everywhere she goes, I see now a lot of people are coming out and actually defending her. But obviously, if you're standing up for something that you believe in, you're going to get hate all the time. But I think she's inspiring not only the players in WNBA but girls from all over the world, not only in America, because I get so many messages and they're saying that from all over the world. They're saying, 'Hey, if you ever see Sophie, can you please say hi to her?'
